findings: Choose an Autoload for isolated global state that must survive scene changes; reusable per-scene behavior can be a named Node or static helper instead.
Avoid global sound pools merely to solve interrupted local playback; consider scene-owned players and lifecycle before centralizing state.
Use RefCounted for lightweight runtime data and Resource when Inspector serialization is needed; Object requires explicit lifetime management.
Evaluate non-Node data objects for very large populations rather than assigning every data element a processing Node.
Keep scene-specific assets near their scenes and track third-party code distinctly; use consistent filename casing because exported PCK paths are case-sensitive.
A .gdignore hides and prevents resource loading for the whole folder; it cannot express patterns and is unsuitable for runnable prototype assets.
Prefer PackedScene for editable game-specific node composition; named scripts work well for reusable types and tools.
Set owner after add_child when building saved scene content; editor custom types do not provide runtime type identity like script classes do.
C# SetScript disposes the previous wrapper; reacquire the wrapper by instance ID before continuing.
Ignore .godot caches and generated CSV .translation files while tracking source assets and text scenes; keep version-specific export credential rules distinct.
Normalize text line endings with project .gitattributes and choose asset-specific LFS rules before committing large assets; do not rewrite existing history casually.
Treat a scripted scene root and its declarative child composition as one encapsulated module.
A script without extends inherits RefCounted and cannot be attached to a Node; distinguish script resources from registered engine ClassDB types.
This page is explicitly marked outdated and still discusses NativeScript/Reference; do not transfer its unqualified complexity or language-speed claims into 4.7 guidance.

Choose arrays for sequential/indexed data and dictionaries for keyed lookup, then profile realistic operations; its C# destructor sample references an undefined node variable and requires correction before use.
Use AnimatedSprite for frame animation, AnimationPlayer for multi-property/timed events, and AnimationTree for blending; verify current deprecated AnimatedTexture limits separately.
Configure local properties before adding nodes to the active tree where possible; global transforms require the final parent context.
Preload constants retain dependencies for the script lifetime; replaceable exported dependencies should not preload a default that the scene immediately overwrites.
Introduce dynamic level streaming only when memory/performance demands it and validate transition/lifetime complexity.
Frame architecture decisions around an observed problem and explicit pros/cons rather than enforcing one universal scene hierarchy.
Navigation index groups scene organization, lifecycle notifications, representation choices, and VCS; use it as a discovery route rather than an API contract.
Loading ordinarily returns cached Resource instances; create or duplicate data when independent mutable state is required.
Inject typed references or Callables for external behavior and validate missing dependencies at runtime; release exports omit GDScript assert checks.
Several C# samples lack partial/override or reference inconsistent Prop casing; use the architecture principle but compile corrected samples.
Enter-tree callbacks run parent-first while ready callbacks run children-first; scene exported values overwrite constructor assignments before tree entry.
Use parented/unparented notifications for off-tree attachment transitions and pair signal connection/disconnection; constructor state must not require active-tree nodes.
NOTIFICATION_POSTINITIALIZE is not accessible to scripts; avoid promoting internal callbacks into public scripting recipes.
Compose external relationships at a shared owner through injected references, Callables, or connected signals; child scenes should not hard-code sibling topology.
Choose hierarchy by lifetime, keeping persistent player/session components outside temporary level branches.
Expose missing dependencies through tool-script configuration warnings; keep authoritative-only network systems separate from per-client controllers.
CollisionShape2D or CollisionPolygon2D must be direct children of a physics body; assign a Shape2D Resource and prefer primitive dynamic-body shapes.
Concave shapes have no solid-volume semantics and belong to static collision; the page still refers to an old RigidBody Static mode, so verify current freeze/body-type APIs before writing recipes.
Use primitives or convex decomposition for moving bodies, and concave trimesh for static level geometry; concave meshes are surfaces without an interior volume.
Keep shape counts/transforms low and profile collision complexity; direct-child CollisionShape3D ownership is required.
Apply forces, impulses, or direct-state velocity in _integrate_forces rather than overriding RigidBody3D global transforms every frame.
Validate target-direction degeneracy and clamped dot products before adapting the angular-velocity look-follow example.
Select body_entered versus area_entered based on target body type, and configure monitoring, monitorability, layers and masks independently.
Overlapping area gravity/damping uses explicit priority and combine/replace policies; test overlapping zones rather than one isolated area.
Run CharacterBody movement in physics callbacks; move_and_collide accepts displacement while move_and_slide uses velocity and handles delta internally.
Change collision shape dimensions instead of scaling the physics body; deliberately implement interactions with dynamic bodies rather than expecting rigid-body simulation.
Queue input-derived ray requests and execute direct-space queries during physics callbacks to avoid locked spaces.
Use global endpoints, appropriate area/body flags, masks and self exclusions; an empty result denotes no hit.
The GDScript sample uses [self] for exclude while C# uses RID values; verify typed PhysicsRayQueryParameters exclusions before copying this mixed-era example.
Enable interpolation, keep transform changes on physics ticks, and reset interpolation after spawning or teleporting; inspect behavior at a deliberately low tick rate.
Do not assume identical server interpolation coverage: 2D interpolation is server-side while 3D server-created bodies require manual interpolation.
The page limits 2D particle interpolation to CPU particles and recommends at least 20-30 physics ticks; check real target engine when choosing particles.
Diagnose tunneling with CCD, thicker simplified colliders and target-budget tick-rate changes before increasing simulation cost globally.
Make shared Shape Resources unique before resizing one instance; in 4.5+ TileMapLayer automatically creates composite colliders controlled by physics quadrant size.
The page calls GodotPhysics the default while the same 4.7 snapshot SoftBody page states new 4.6+ projects use Jolt; inspect actual project setting rather than repeating this conflicting default.
Use PhysicalBoneSimulator3D with selected necessary physical bones; tune joints before shape placement and exclude the character collider from self-collision.
Partial simulation accepts skeleton bone names, not PhysicalBone node names; invalid names are silent, so assert requested bones exist before starting.
Control animation override strength via simulator influence and restore AnimationTree activation after authoring previews.
SoftBody3D derives collision/rendering from its own mesh; tune tessellation and simulation precision instead of adding ordinary shape children.
Attach cloak pinned vertices to BoneAttachment3D through attachment paths without parenting the whole soft body under the moving bone; configure parent collision ignore.
Imported mesh LOD simplification can erase desired bending detail; adjust LOD generation and account for absent physics interpolation support.
Move direct and indirect transforms, including animation/tween parents, onto physics timing when automatically interpolated.
Reset interpolation after setting spawn/teleport transform; a moving-start projectile can then set its first simulated transform.
3D debug collision wireframes are not interpolated, so apparent wireframe lead relative to rendered bodies is not itself a collision error.
A child with interpolation off still inherits an interpolated parent transform; detach or use top_level for manually controlled cameras.
Use get_global_transform_interpolated sparingly for rendered camera targets while gameplay reads current physics state.
Correct obsolete Transform annotation to Transform3D in the example before use; keep mouse-look rotation responsive without automatic interpolation.
Connect region edges with exact matching endpoints or near-parallel edges within map edge margin; avoid overlapping mesh interiors.
Use NavigationLink for arbitrary gaps and test crossings after synchronization; edge-margin changes rebuild connections across the map.
Navigation debug visualization is debug-build-only and scene-node-based; server-only changes may not appear.
Navigation Process excludes pathfinding query cost, so profile queries separately from map updates/avoidance.
Represent access-controlled doors with traversable region layers and select actor query masks; disabled region blocks all queries.
Layer changes affect new paths only and updating region masks rebuilds connections; prefer query-mask changes where suitable.
Bake separate standing/crouching/crawling maps with appropriate heights and query the matching map on locomotion changes.
Switch avoidance maps independently and allow server synchronization before expecting changed avoidance behavior.
Maps isolate pathfinding/avoidance; acquire the default from World2D/World3D or create and activate explicit maps for alternate actor types.
Regions/agents belong to one map at a time and queued switches apply on server synchronization.
Assign NavigationPolygon/NavigationMesh data and the intended map; direct server-created regions need explicit map assignment.
Region transforms update server geometry but scaling requires rebaking; disabling regions does not invalidate an already stored path automatically.
Prefer per-query/agent masks over changing region availability for actor access; region changes synchronize later.
Layer-value helper APIs are one-based while bit shifts are zero-based; the page labels 1 << 4 as fourth layer, so correct off-by-one examples before adoption.
A link joins nearest valid endpoint polygons within link connection radius and may be one-way; it does not implement jumping, teleporting or platform boarding.
Use path metadata or gameplay triggers to execute special traversal, and test missing endpoints plus reversed direction.
Profile scene parsing, background baking, path queries and map synchronization separately; simplify geometry and avoid GPU mesh readbacks during play.
Repath only after meaningful target movement and stagger agent updates; test unreachable destinations because exhaustive search exposes excessive polygon counts.
Prefer matching region vertices over expensive edge connection rebuilding; do not claim larger map area alone determines query cost.
Bake and activate separate maps for actor radius/height classes rather than changing avoidance radius and expecting new obstacle clearance.
Parse scene source geometry on the main thread, reuse data across agent-size bakes, then wait for map synchronization before initial path queries; sample omits this wait.
A non-empty path can end at the closest reachable point on the starting island; compare final endpoint with target tolerance to assert actual cross-region reachability.
Use funnel optimization for free movement and edge-center paths for regular grids; this raw Node3D transform-following example does not provide physical collision handling.
Queue setters and deletion then await physics synchronization before querying updated maps; node cached getter values may lead server getter values in the same frame.
Avoidance safe velocities are dispatched within the physics frame before physics synchronization, so move a physics body in that callback.
Free directly allocated map/region RIDs during cleanup; the setup snippet is illustrative and lacks explicit teardown.
Separate baked obstruction contribution from runtime avoidance; enabling avoidance alone does not update pathfinding geometry.
Use radius/velocity for moving soft avoidance obstacles; static vertex boundaries rebuild on movement and only affect 2D avoidance, with winding defining inside/outside.
Correct the enabled_avoidance typo to avoidance_enabled and missing equals sign in the C# obstacle array before using samples.
Reuse query parameter/result pairs, guard never-synchronized maps, and request only needed point metadata.
Region exclusion wins inclusion; search limits truncate exploration while return-length/radius limits only clip postprocessed output, so only search limits reduce search cost.
Filtered or limited searches can return partial/wrong-direction paths; assert endpoint reachability and use metadata to take over link traversal.
NavigationAgent never moves its parent; call get_next_path_position once per physics tick while unfinished and move using body-specific code.
Avoidance is independent of physical collision and navmesh boundaries; use safe velocity with realistic speed/horizon/radius settings and test crowded cases.

Several Node2D/C# Node3D samples submit per-tick displacement as avoidance velocity while CharacterBody samples submit units per second; correct velocity units and apply delta only when integrating position.
The page claims target_position is mandatory even for avoidance-only agents; verify engine behavior before adopting this restriction.
Request threaded loading, poll status/progress across frames, and call load_threaded_get only after loaded status to guarantee nonblocking retrieval.
Handle failed/invalid requests before instantiation; the button example retrieves immediately on click and can still block if clicked early.
Use res:// for packaged resources and user:// for saves/settings; exported resource filesystem is generally read-only.
Use forward-slash paths and globalize/localize only when native paths are needed; editor self-contained mode does not make exported games portable.
Web user:// is IndexedDB-backed virtual storage; mobile sandbox and custom user directory choices need platform-specific verification.
Define save participants and explicit serializable fields; encode Vector/Color/Quaternion values deliberately for JSON.
Stage and validate loaded state before replacing live objects; tutorial frees current participants before parse and lacks schema migration/recovery handling.
Nested save participants need stable identity and parents-first reconstruction because saved NodePaths can change; binary property storage depends on PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE.
Use raw loaders for user-supplied content and normal ResourceLoader for packaged project assets; runtime raw loading bypasses import/remap optimizations.
Set GLTFState base_path when loading buffers with external dependencies; FBX runtime load is supported but save uses glTF.
Generate mipmaps for runtime images displayed at changing scales and inspect return errors for images/fonts/audio.
Use distinct input/output paths when duplicating ZIP archives; the illustrative sample reuses path and could truncate its source.
Prefer hardware custom cursors over a frame-updated sprite for lower latency; set hotspot and per-shape cursor explicitly.
Keep cursor images within target limits: 256px maximum generally, 128px on Web; validate real platform behavior.
Disable automatic quit acceptance when confirmation/save must complete; explicit SceneTree.quit does not issue a close request first.
Save on application pause for mobile rather than relying on desktop close notification; propagate custom close requests before final quit if needed.
Use viewport coordinates for gameplay and explicitly convert spaces for transformed content.
Captured mouse position stays centered; use screen_relative/screen_velocity for resolution-independent mouselook.
Set CharacterBody2D velocity from Input.get_vector and call move_and_slide in physics callbacks without multiplying velocity by delta.
Click-move sample combines global target with local position; use one consistent space under transformed parents and clamp arrival motion to prevent overshoot.
Use CanvasLayer for HUD and transitions independent of camera canvas transform; layer number controls cross-layer draw order.
Use tree ordering/z_index for ordinary sprite ordering rather than adding a CanvasLayer for every visual.
Page is marked outdated; validate editor conversion menus before prescribing them.
Consider trimmed 2D geometry for large transparent sprites when fill-rate is measured as bottleneck; compare visual edges and GPU cost before retaining the conversion.
Choose Line2D/custom-draw antialiasing for supported geometry; 2D MSAA is only Forward+/Mobile and has separate settings from 3D.
MSAA does not smooth transparent sprite interior edges, shader aliasing or text; choose asset/filter/font remedies for those cases.
Use make_input_local for viewport events entering a transformed CanvasItem; affine inverse converts canvas coordinates back to local.
When synthesizing focused-window mouse events, apply viewport screen transform and global-with-canvas transform in order; test stretch and letterboxing.
Build SpriteFrames for individual/sheet frames, or animate Sprite2D frame with AnimationPlayer when multiple properties need synchronization.
AnimationPlayer.play applies on the next processing update; call advance(0) only when an immediate pose is needed to avoid a flip/property mismatch frame.
Blend two animations with a typical 0-1 amount; choose AnimationNodeAdd2 for intentional amplified/additive contributions instead.
Use band-limit to attenuate a wider frequency band while preserving frequencies outside it; distinguish from band-pass and notch when freeing mix space.
AudioStreamMicrophone requires audio/driver/enable_input and OS permission; route through capture processing and avoid accidental speaker feedback.
CenterContainer lays out children at minimum size; use_top_left centers around its origin rather than the container rectangle center.
CSharpScript represents a .cs resource and new instantiates it; availability requires the .NET-enabled Godot build, not the standard native executable.
EditorExportPlatformPC covers Windows and Linux/BSD, excluding macOS; choose the actual derived exporter before using platform options.
Blend import invokes installed Blender through the glTF pipeline and requires configured binary path and enabled project import setting; preserve external texture references.
FBX2GLTF importer is an optional external-tool path activated by its project setting; do not make it a prerequisite for the native FBX importer.
This generated class page supplies inheritance only with no description or local members; use GLTFDocument/import tutorials for actionable behavior instead of inventing methods.
Choose JacobianIK3D when smooth biological joint motion matters more than immediate target convergence; it preserves prior forward-axis twist.

boundary: Custom Lightmapper implementation is C++ engine-module development outside guaranteed plugin execution.
findings: Use built-in LightmapperRD for supported GPU baking; this abstract page does not expose a scripted custom lightmapper implementation path.
Node3DGizmo has no exposed API; use an EditorNode3DGizmo with Node3D.add_gizmo for editor integrations.
ORMMaterial3D packs ambient occlusion, roughness and metallic into one texture; other settings inherit BaseMaterial3D.
Use StyleBoxEmpty to deliberately override a style with no drawing; preserve another visible keyboard-focus indicator if replacing focus decoration.

boundary: Enabling this backend requires a custom engine build outside guaranteed execution.
findings: Fallback text server omits BiDi and complex layout and is absent from official binaries; do not suggest it for localization without explicit script coverage checks.
Theora video decoding is CPU-based; use .ogv for imported project videos and account for decode cost in frame budget.
Provide matching-space surface normal and view direction to obtain Fresnel falloff; inspect both frontal and grazing-angle output.
ProximityFade computes per-pixel fade near other geometry; use visual occlusion/intersection checks rather than asserting only graph compilation.
RotationByAxis transforms mesh vertices about an axis using radians; verify pivot/coordinate space before using it for apparent object rotation.
ScreenUVToSDF defaults to SCREEN_UV when unconnected and maps screen UV into SDF sampling coordinates.
Texture2DParameter defines sampler2D uniform input; a sampling node still needs the parameter assigned and UV supplied.
TextureSDFNormal samples the SDF normal using sdf_pos, so convert screen coordinates before connecting screen-UV inputs.
TransformDecompose outputs four vec3 matrix components, not Euler angles; validate matrix layout against shader generation before using translation/basis outputs.
VectorRefract takes incident direction, surface normal and index ratio eta; keep directions in the same space and distinguish ratio from a material absolute IOR.
VectorDecompose separates vector channels to scalars, including 4D components; choose the vector port dimension intentionally.
Define a varying with stage-compatible mode before adding its getter; vertex-to-fragment/light data must use the corresponding varying mode.
CubemapParameter exposes a samplerCube uniform to the cubemap sampling node; ordinary 2D UV sampling is inappropriate.

boundary: Internal render-server frame data is consumed from render callbacks, not constructed as a standalone gameplay object.
findings: Do not instantiate RenderSceneDataRD from scripts; inspect supplied RenderData/RenderSceneData for the active frame instead.
Page is explicitly outdated and covers scene-linear lighting, not detailed 4.7 HDR display-output configuration; use separate HDR-output guide and article.
Do not reproduce obsolete advice about enabling paired sRGB Environment conversion switches; confirm actual renderer color pipeline and texture hints.
Place Camera3D directly under SpringArm3D to use its near-plane pyramid sweep; otherwise supply an explicit shape because fallback ray is inaccurate.
Rotate a pivot with screen_relative mouselook and clamp pitch; test self-collision masks and wall corner clearance.
Page is marked outdated and demonstrates editor surface scattering; verify current populate workflow and use MultiMesh class API for deterministic generated placement.
Use weak shadowless, specular-disabled secondary lights as a low-cost diffuse bounce approximation when GI/baking is unsuitable.
Fade outdoor fill lights indoors to avoid light leakage and pair fake diffuse bounce with reflection probes for specular response.
Assign Curve2D to Path2D and parent PathFollow2D beneath it; start curve at zero for expected follower-child relative placement.
Separators are visual Controls, with theme separation acting as minimum size; enable StyleBoxLine.vertical for a VSeparator theme.
Set segment endpoints a/b in shape-local space and attach the Resource to CollisionShape2D; a segment is not a filled polygon.
SphereOccluder3D supplies a world-unit radius shape to OccluderInstance3D; use it only where conservative occlusion matches opaque geometry.
Plane normal defines the allowed half-space; Jolt represents this otherwise-infinite boundary with a configurable finite size, so verify distant-world collision.
Break RefCounted reference cycles using weakref on non-owning relationships and handle get_ref returning null after deletion.
A PlaceholderMaterial can indicate dedicated-server resource stripping or an unavailable material subclass; inspect build/module compatibility before treating it as successful visual loading.
PlaceholderMesh preserves local AABB while omitting render content for server/missing-subclass cases; do not count it as a rendered mesh asset.
Use window_id to identify the receiving Window when dispatching window-based input; this abstract base is not itself a concrete input event.
Read axis and axis_value as one analog-axis sample with nominal -1 to 1 range; implement dead zones in actions or explicit interpretation rather than treating motion as a pressed button.
The colors accessor returns a copy of the packed array; assign a modified array back to persist palette edits.
Inspect get_vertices and get_indices on the occluder Resource to diagnose the geometry submitted by an OccluderInstance3D.
Use texture_rd_rid only when integrating a RenderingDevice-managed 3D texture; choose ordinary Texture3D resources for normal imported content.
This TextureLayeredRD specialization wraps a RenderingDevice cubemap; ordinary Cubemap is the default content workflow.
Use this wrapper for RenderingDevice cubemap-array interoperability and ordinary CubemapArray for standard resource workflows.
Enable filter_clip to reduce neighboring atlas pixel bleed; AtlasTexture does not tile normally and is unsupported inside AnimatedTexture.
Bus effects are Resources whose _instantiate creates per-bus effect instances; retain the Resource reference when custom instances need live property updates.
volume_linear is a convenience conversion of volume_db, not an independent gain stage; positive dB gain requires downstream clipping checks.
The raw-buffer _process override is useful only through GDExtension, not GDScript or C#; _process_silence can deliberately keep a muted bus processing.
Consume stereo float PCM regularly and monitor discarded_frames for ring-buffer overruns; set buffer_length before initialization and avoid clear_buffer during continuous playback.
Tune dry and wet independently and use predelay_msec for the separation of direct sound and early reflections; use Delay when a distinct echo is required.
make_current overrides the camera listener and the last made-current listener wins even if multiple report current; align listener/player Doppler tracking with their movement callback.
Obtain the interactive playback component from the player to switch clips by name or index; inspect current clip index to verify the actual music state.
Playlist supports at most 64 sequential substreams, reshuffles at start and loop, and expects trailing audio beyond each stream end for its transition fade.
Up to 32 streams begin together; playback lasts until the last ends and continues if any substream loops. Change stem gain with set_sync_stream_volume using dB.

AreaLight3D emits along negative Z and costs extra on all Forward+ rendered objects when present in the frustum; Mobile has reduced penumbra quality and Compatibility supports neither area shadows nor texture sources.
Normalize energy when resizing the emitter; avoid frequent texture swaps and prefer texture dimensions that are powers of two or multiples of 128 to avoid atlas scaling passes.
get_length returns zero for indefinite generators/microphones and the last played stream length for Randomizer; zero is not necessarily failed loading.

Custom stream implementations create separate playback state with _instantiate_playback; experimental sampling APIs require explicit version checks. Verify is_monophonic semantics against source before using the page wording as a channel-count test.
Changing stream stops active sounds; finished is absent for explicit stop and tree exit. Test cleanup without waiting for finished on interrupted playback.
Missing buses silently fall back to Master; validate bus existence. Polyphony cuts oldest voices, and get_playback_position always returns zero for interactive streams.
Hiding the node does not mute audio; play queues playback until the next physics frame. Wait a physics frame for behavioral assertions.
The default listener is screen center, area_mask defaults to zero, and unresolved buses fall back to Master; inspect these before changing volume for inaudible positional sound.
animation_finished is absent for looping animations; zero speed still counts as playing. Check frame progression instead of is_playing alone.
Pause preserves frame progress while stop resets it; use set_frame_and_progress when changing skins without restarting the gait.

A default output node must receive the desired final graph output; connect_node takes the consuming input node, its port, then the producing output node. Validate graph connectivity through saved-resource playback, not editor coordinates.
Retrieve per-AnimationTree playback state to travel; grouped machines require a root or nested ancestor and cannot work independently.

Self travel only restarts when allow_transition_to_self and the playback reset option permit it; graph coordinates affect editor display only. Verify the C# Variant conversion in the sample before compiling it.
Raw 8-bit data must be signed PCM, QOA expects a full encoded file, and the data accessor returns a copy requiring reassignment. Loop markers are sample counts, not seconds.
save_to_wav cannot export ADPCM or QOA; check its Error and reload the resulting WAV for duration/channel assertions. Runtime load options use ResourceImporterWAV names.
Use toggled for a new toggle value and set_pressed_no_signal for model-to-view updates to avoid command feedback loops. This silent setter does not unpress other ButtonGroup members.
Press/release action_mode determines activation timing; keep_pressed_outside affects appearance only, and disabling a held button emits button_up.
height includes the semicircles whereas mid_height excludes them; dimensions auto-adjust when full height is less than twice radius. Read back dimensions after resize.

Lossless/lossy disk compression does not reduce GPU memory; choose GPU-compressed import formats based on actual renderer support and artifacts. The page lists Basis Universal but inconsistently says only VRAM Compressed reduces memory; verify import behavior before copying this claim.

Require closed manifold geometry and avoid moving CSG operands during gameplay because rebuilding is CPU-expensive. ArrayMesh attributes beyond vertices, normals, and UVs are unused; normals are recalculated except for flat-face detection.
The page warns of known cylinder collision bugs and recommends capsule or box alternatives; reproduce with the selected physics backend before choosing a workaround.
Implement all three required extension, active, and support-query callbacks for importer setup; returning false from _query prevents import continuation.
Register globally with ScriptEditor to apply on script opening or add to one ScriptEditorBase; supply fresh highlighter instances with _create and declare supported language names.
Use EditorInterface.get_editor_toaster instead of instantiating EditorToaster; communicate plugin result and severity through push_toast.
Use this wrapper for inspector/debugger object IDs, resolving through instance_from_id; instance IDs are runtime identifiers and do not define stable save-game entity identity.
Cached RenderingDevice framebuffers survive only while their dependent textures exist; empty pass definitions derive attachments from texture usage flags.
Particle collision requires RIGID or HIDE_ON_CONTACT process material mode and affects GPUParticles3D only; nonuniform collider scaling is unsupported.
Implement additional image formats through ImageFormatLoaderExtension; FORCE_LINEAR converts sRGB and CONVERT_COLORS applies editor-theme remapping, so avoid unintended double conversion.
A mesh fit to opaque pixels trades more vertex processing for lower fill cost; use Sprite2D conversion and compare representative viewport sizes before claiming improvement.
Use a MultiMesh resource for many similar 2D mesh instances; fitting geometry to opaque pixels reduces fill cost but still adds vertex work.
Mutex is reentrant: each successful lock or try_lock requires a matching unlock. Join/finish workers and release every lock before Mutex or Thread destruction.
Register backends at server initialization only; the manager cannot switch physics servers during runtime. A default changes only when its priority exceeds the current default.
Backend selection is a startup decision, not a gameplay toggle; register a factory Callable at server initialization and set priority deliberately.
Dedicated-server stripping or unavailable Texture3D subclasses preserve dimensions through placeholders; these resources cannot be treated as renderable texture data.
Check has_uuid before persisting an anchor reference and react to uuid_changed; experimental OpenXR runtime support requires device testing.
Render the SubViewport on an inward cylinder slice; set radius, central angle, and aspect ratio together, and inspect fallback_segments when native composition support is absent.
Custom interaction-profile editors receive both action map and profile through setup; preserve the mapping between edits and that supplied resource context.
Pass this experimental configuration to create_spatial_context before reading enabled components; detecting QR markers remains runtime/device dependent.
Read entity poses by result index from query_snapshot anchor component data; tie interpretation to the corresponding snapshot and entity ordering.
Combine get_center_pose and get_size for each indexed bounding box; dimensions alone do not encode the box orientation or placement.
Retrieve vertices and indices using the correct snapshot RID and apply get_transform for placement; experimental spatial-mesh reading requires a supported OpenXR runtime.
Construct face layers in X+, X-, Y+, Y-, Z+, Z- order. PanoramaSkyMaterial cannot consume a Cubemap directly; use a sky ShaderMaterial samplerCube or convert to an equirectangular panorama.
Layered placeholders preserve per-layer size and layer count for stripped dedicated-server resources or missing subclasses, but do not preserve usable shader texture contents.
Use a planar non-self-intersecting polygon with few points; triangulation fails on intersecting edges. Reassign the copied polygon array after edits and use ArrayOccluder3D for arbitrary 3D geometry.
PopupPanel stretches child controls like a panel container and styles its background with the panel StyleBox; use Window for general window behavior.
QuadMesh is a PlaneMesh with default FACE_Z orientation on XY; it has no thickness and requires billboard material behavior to continuously face the camera.

Hit groups bind ray-tracing shaders by table index; triangle geometry must omit the intersection shader whereas non-triangle geometry requires one. Experimental RD ray-tracing remains hardware dependent.
This GDExtension-facing RenderData implementation supplies camera/environment RIDs and scene buffer/data objects; retain as a low-level renderer boundary, not a standard gameplay script recipe.
Define a bbcode member and install the effect; _process_custom_fx must return success. Any installed effect makes RichTextLabel continuously process when unpaused, so measure battery/per-frame cost.
Use separation rays for stairs-style separation rather than observation ray casts; slide_on_slope changes both separation direction and reported normal.
Only the first override node in tree order applies; inspect shader_overrides_group_active and test restoration of project values after removal.
Only current RenderingDevice shader fragments are registered; test has_built_in_include_file before depending on an internal include and pin its layout against engine updates.
Check listening and pending connection state separately, then take a StreamPeerSocket; stop only stops listening and is not specified as closing already accepted peers.
All array layers need equal dimensions and mip counts; each layer has independent mipmaps and no interpolation between layers, unlike Texture3D.
VideoStream subclasses create playback through required _instantiate_playback; Theora file paths should identify .ogv files rather than arbitrary video containers.
Wait a frame after insertion before checking is_on_screen; hidden nodes do not function and the heuristic ignores walls without occlusion culling, so do not use it as a gameplay line-of-sight check.
The active Camera3D can override environment, camera attributes, and compositor defaults; diagnose the camera overrides before changing WorldEnvironment values.
Vertical slider minimum is bottom and maximum top, opposite to VScrollBar; verify expected control direction in volume/settings interfaces.
Use a CurveXYZTexture lookup when three independently authored curves are needed and assign the source Resource explicitly.
Set randomness operand type to scalar or vec2/vec3/vec4 and provide matching min/max values; this is shader pseudo-random particle data, not gameplay RNG state.
Switch selects between same-typed values using a boolean condition; select op_type to match floats, integers, vectors, booleans, or transforms before wiring inputs.

Choose GDScript/C# for ordinary gameplay and GDExtension for compiled algorithms or SDK integration; engine modules require a distinct source-build workflow and console deployment is not a standard export promise.
Use reusable nested scenes as entities or UI modules and connect signals for event notification; scene-tree parentage and class inheritance are distinct design relationships.
The page routes absolute beginners to external interactive foundations; keep operational Skill recipes self-contained instead of making this external course a prerequisite.
Introduction routes core concepts, editor orientation, research methods, and engine philosophy; use this as foundational navigation rather than an API implementation recipe.
The beginner sequence proceeds from scenes and instancing through scripting/input/signals before the first game; development recipes should check those project foundations before game-specific steps.

Godot favors flexible scene composition and inheritance rather than mandating a strict component framework. @tool runs project code in the editor but does not make the statically compiled editor a loadable project.
2D units are pixels and 3D uses a separate renderer; terrain and complex character authoring may require external tools or addons.
Combine concept tutorials with inherited class-reference members; diagnostic reports need the intended behavior, exact error, script text, scene structure, and actual engine version.

Live adjustments in the Game workspace are not saved when play stops; persist edits in source scenes/resources and verify reload. Contextual toolbars and dock layout can differ, so avoid brittle UI-coordinate instructions.
F6 runs the current scene whereas F5 runs the configured main scene; verify application/run/main_scene when startup behavior differs from isolated scene tests.
Instance property overrides survive source-scene updates; make shared Resources unique for instance-specific changes. Scene instancing is distinct from GPU hardware instancing.
The blanket advice to dismiss MVC is introductory context, not a prohibition on separating large-project systems and UI. Prefer scene-first composition and add boundaries for demonstrated coupling.
Select language using platform availability and measured algorithm cost; most gameplay calls engine C++ regardless of script language. C# needs a .NET editor and has documented web-export limits.
The page says .NET 8 and makes broad GDExtension/compiler claims; version-match SDK requirements and generated bindings before carrying these forward as setup instructions.

Use radians and per-second speed multiplied by delta for direct transforms; direct Sprite2D position updates do not perform collision response. C# Godot subclasses are partial and filenames match class names.

Use polling for continuous movement and unhandled input for discrete gameplay events after UI consumption. The text conflates is_action_pressed with just-pressed; choose the correct state versus edge API.
The sample uses UI actions and gives right input precedence when both are held; production controls should define dedicated actions and explicit opposing-input behavior.
The portrait recipe uses 480x720 canvas_items stretch with keep aspect and separates Player, Mob, HUD, and Main; choose target-specific layout instead of treating these dimensions as a default.
This complete-game sequence covers spawn, movement, score, and restart rather than single-node success; keep demo/starter links version pinned when using them as design references.

Area2D provides overlap detection for this teaching example; choose CharacterBody2D when player movement needs collision response. Add a child CollisionShape2D and align shape dimensions separately from sprite scale.

For straight-moving RigidBody2D mobs, disable gravity and undesired collision masks, assign collision shape and notifier, and remove them on screen exit. Verify animation lists are nonempty before random selection.

Connect start-game action through the Button Shortcut, route music play/stop through game lifecycle, and package executable plus PCK for export. Recheck looping import settings rather than assuming every audio file starts nonlooping.
Normalize directional input to prevent faster diagonals and distinguish exported scene values from script defaults. Match node and animation names exactly.
Defer collision-shape disabling from overlap callbacks, but add an immediate dead/hit guard to prevent duplicate events before the deferred mutation; reset that guard on restart.
The sample caches viewport size once and clamps local position by it; resize-aware or transformed-parent recipes need updated bounds and consistent coordinates.

Export a PackedScene and initialize spawn properties before add_child; a clockwise closed Path2D gives inward normals in this recipe. Transform spawn positions/directions correctly when parent transforms change.
Stop startup, spawn, and score work consistently on game-over; timer callbacks need state guards to prevent delayed start from reviving a finished session.
HUD emits start intent while Main manages game lifecycle and supplies score values. Group cleanup removes old mobs on restart.

Awaited game-over timers can outlive the current session or scene; cancellation/session tokens and lifetime checks are required for reusable UI, and repeated font overrides should become a shared Theme.
Connect first-class signals to Callables for checked names and use C# typed events or SignalName; editor connections must resolve actual methods even if the icon appears.

set_process changes only idle processing, not child Timer activity; signal lifecycle tests should include detach/re-add and ensure no duplicate callbacks. Guard health-depleted emission on the alive-to-dead transition.
Pair floor StaticBody3D collision and mesh under one parent so visual and physics placement remain aligned. A thick box reduces tunneling risk but is not proof against arbitrary fast motion.

Use CharacterBody3D for controlled collision-aware motion and place visual rotation under a Pivot distinct from the collider. Dedicated InputMap actions support keyboard and analog controller bindings.
Do not assume controller device indices permanently match plug order; test hotplug/multiplayer assignment through actual device IDs.
The sequence integrates movement, spawning, jump/squash collisions, death, replay, UI, and animation; these give end-to-end behavior checkpoints rather than isolated script-start checks.
After the tutorial, route next work to core scripting, 3D physics, and input concepts; official manual coverage explains engine features rather than guaranteeing genre-specific implementation.
Keep CharacterBody3D velocity in units per second, apply delta to acceleration, and let move_and_slide apply the timestep. Querying is_on_floor before movement observes the previous move result.
Guard a zero direction before Basis.looking_at and explicitly convert direction when the Pivot parent is transformed. Digital action checks discard analog stick strength.

The tutorial keeps target_velocity separate from collision-adjusted velocity; define grounded resets and desired-versus-resolved velocity ownership to prevent vertical acceleration accumulating while standing. Orthographic camera far distance also affects directional shadow quality.
Fit enemy colliders to intended hit fairness, and use visibility notifications for lifecycle cleanup while checking that gameplay should actually stop off-screen.
move_and_slide can modify velocity after obstacle collision despite the example description of constant speed; restore desired movement only when the chosen behavior requires it.

Pooling can reduce allocation and physics registration stalls in GDScript as well as garbage-collected languages; measure spawn and removal costs rather than adopting the page language distinction as a rule.
Use a closed spawn Path3D around the camera, randomize PathFollow3D progress_ratio, and validate the exported PackedScene and expected instance type before timed spawning.

The sample combines a marker position relative to SpawnPath with a player position relative to Main and an orientation operation using global coordinates; convert both positions into one explicit space when parents are transformed.
Stop the spawn timer when the target player is removed, and verify initialization order for look_at_from_position before add_child instead of assuming every method works outside the scene tree.

Use named collision layers with player mask detecting enemies and world, and optional enemy mask for enemy-enemy interaction. A zero mask does not make a body invisible to another body that masks its layer.
The sample loops slide collisions before move_and_slide, so its claim of collisions from this frame is inaccurate; define movement-before-inspection and explicit bounce application timing.

Group tagging does not guarantee a squash method contract. A positive up-normal dot threshold classifies approach geometry, while a dead guard makes squash idempotent across callers; queue_free is deferred, so a null-only guard cannot ensure that.
Use a monitoring Area3D with enemy mask and no layer for damage sensing; adjust hitbox height and width separately from the movement collider to tune squash versus damage timing.
The geometric hitbox heuristic approximates grounded vulnerability; explicitly gate damage by state when invulnerability or aerial immunity must be guaranteed.
Set a dead flag before emitting hit and queue_free so multiple entered bodies cannot trigger repeated game-over effects; stop the spawn timer synchronously before removing its player dependency.
A parent Control Theme supplies default font and size to child labels; local theme overrides take priority. Full Rect children require the parent to have the intended viewport bounds.
Keeping score on a Label is acceptable for a prototype; move state into a model when persistence or multiple presentations must share it. Connect spawned mob signals before readiness can emit them.
Use an Autoload AudioStreamPlayer for music continuity across scene reloads, and check reload_current_scene result while guarding repeated retry requests.
The complete C# checkpoint uses GetNode<Player>("Player").position rather than Position; compile the adaptation instead of counting tutorial source as runtime evidence.

Animate a visual Character child while movement owns the physics root and orientation owns Pivot; assigning the same animated property from code creates ownership conflicts. Save RESET baseline and verify animation tracks after scene reload.
Copied animations require matching node paths and property types, not merely similar appearance; verify root_node, library naming, autoplay and loop configuration on each destination scene.
Validate nonzero jump_impulse and min_speed before using them as animation scale divisors. Clamp pitch if falling speed can grow beyond the intended visual range.
The final C# code adds JumpImpulse to retained vertical target velocity while GDScript assigns it; use a deliberate velocity reset to avoid language-dependent jump behavior.
Prefer Parallax2D to legacy ParallaxBackground and ParallaxLayer; give independently scrolling layers separate nodes and use scroll_scale as axis-specific camera motion multipliers.

Diagnose repeat gaps by ensuring content starts at the repeat canvas origin, covers repeat_size in effective scaled units, and remains large enough under minimum camera zoom. Use scroll_offset for phase changes and repeat_times for zoom coverage.

Shared World2D split-screen needs per-camera parallax instances, filtered by viewport canvas_cull_mask and ancestor CanvasItem visibility_layer; one moving parallax cannot represent two camera positions.

Choose GPU particles by default but compare CPU particles on low-end or GPU-limited hardware; conversion can lose GPU-only features. A GPU emitter needs a process material as well as a display texture.
A flipbook also needs CanvasItemMaterial particle animation enabled with matching H/V frame counts; select blend mode according to actual transparency, not every dark-looking texture.

Regenerate visibility_rect across worst-case particle lifetime and movement when particles disappear near viewport boundaries; distinguish global trails from local_coords attached effects. Preprocess incurs simulation work and is a warm-start mechanism.

This page is explicitly outdated and repeats a Godot 4.3 physics interpolation warning plus an old randomness formula. Verify 4.7 class properties and interpolation behavior instead of assuming the branch makes every paragraph current.
Particle parameters sample a min/max range at spawn then multiply by the lifetime curve; initial velocity must be nonzero for direction, spread and directed emission to have visible motion.
For flipbooks, speed one traverses the sheet over the particle lifetime; frozen random variants use speed zero with randomized offset. Check fixed simulation FPS against intended frame progression.

Generate solid, border or directed-border emission data through Load Emission Mask rather than assigning an ordinary image to generated point/color data textures. Directed borders require initial velocity.
Conversion to ShaderMaterial preserves the enabled feature implementation at conversion time; inspect generated shader and take ownership of future feature changes.

Build 2D lighting with CanvasModulate ambient darkening, lights and explicit LightOccluder2D polygons. The viewport background clear color cannot receive lighting; provide a rendered background texture instead.

Diagnose missing shadows separately from weak normal-map lighting: shadow enabled needs an occluder and matching masks, while normal mapped light height affects brightness but not directional shadow length. Directional shadows are infinite unless replaced by an SDF shader.

Receiving-light cull masks and casting-shadow occluder masks are distinct; the page Range Item Cull Mask description conflates receiver visual layers with Occluder Light Mask, so verify class properties.

2D shadow resolution follows the viewport rather than sprite texels. Nearest filtering alone cannot pixelate lighting; a custom LIGHT_VERTEX/SHADOW_VERTEX snap needs a positive grid size and visual validation.

Prefer inexpensive additive sprites for appropriate short-lived effects only when shadows and normal/specular response are unnecessary; compare light screen coverage and shadow filter costs before replacing lights.
Use this index to route 2D rendering, movement and TileSet tools; skeleton animation, navigation and general physics are in separate sections and must be included for a complete gameplay task.
Use Node2D for game-space objects and Control for GUI layout; both share CanvasItem drawing, and 3D embedded in a 2D scene needs a SubViewport.
Editor selection grouping differs from runtime Node groups. Locked nodes remain selectable through the tree, and drag-drop modifiers determine whether assets become siblings or children.

Editor pixel snapping only affects authored transform placement; runtime Node2D snapping and GUI snap-controls settings are separate. Check relative snapping offsets when grid-aligned assets remain misaligned.
Use viewport frame-selection and rulers to diagnose missing or mispositioned content, while theme and canvas-scale previews support authoring but do not replace runtime resolution tests.

CanvasItem drawing commands are cached; call queue_redraw when geometry, style or text arguments change, while changing node transforms does not require rebuilding draw commands. Validate null textures before drawing.
Drawing uses item-local coordinates, so the mouse example using Viewport.get_mouse_position must convert input through the item transform when the node or camera is translated or scaled.
Use PackedVector2Array for polygon points, distinguish closed polygon fills from open polylines, and batch disconnected segments with draw_multiline when profiling shows command overhead.

Odd-width half-pixel alignment assumes the intended screen transform; test scaling and rotation instead of blindly shifting local coordinates. draw_set_transform lets cached geometry use a chosen local pivot.

Tool drawing needs scene reload and C# rebuild after annotation changes. Guard editor execution from runtime mutations; property setters should request redraw so inspector changes are immediately visible.

draw_string requires explicit font and baseline position; ThemeDB.fallback_font is a fallback and should not be mistaken for a custom Control theme font. SVG textures are rasterized resources rather than guaranteed resolution-independent node output.

Use separate TileMapLayer nodes for foreground and background, and externalize the TileSet resource for reuse across levels; deleting a layer deletes its placed cells. Y-sorted layers group by Y rather than rendering_quadrant_size.
Prefer an optimized baked NavigationRegion2D mesh after designing large tile levels; overlapping visual layers do not justify overlapping navigation meshes on the same navigation map.
Terrain Connect joins surrounding compatible tiles while Path links the painted stroke, preserving adjacent separate roads. Check changed neighbor cells and edge transitions after procedural updates.
Patterns are stored in the TileSet even though authored in the TileMap editor, so they are shared when the resource is shared. Noncontiguous selections preserve empty spaces.

Removed source tiles leave persisted invalid cell identifiers whose editor placeholders may only appear after selecting the layer; inspect source, atlas coordinate and alternative IDs before assuming serialization deleted cells.

Set logical TileSet size before automatic atlas creation and configure atlas region size, margins and separation for the actual sheet. Changing these later can invalidate existing coordinates and needs migration through tile proxies.
Use atlas tiles for ordinary decoration and scenes collections for interactive node behavior; each scene tile is separately instantiated and carries lifecycle and performance costs.

Physics, navigation and occlusion data require distinct TileSet layers and polygons. Paint repeated shapes in batches, then inspect affected alternatives rather than assuming visual tiles automatically collide.
Custom data belongs to the TileSet tile definition and is shared by every placed cell; keep per-cell mutable state separately or choose an alternative tile for a static metadata variation.

Terrain-set and terrain IDs are independent zero-based identifiers with minus one representing absent terrain. Choose sides/corners matching mode and configure appropriate peering bits and all required transitions.
Alternatives do not inherit the base tile properties. Verify collision, terrain, metadata and material again after creating one; changing its ID breaks existing placed references.

Check target GPU texture limits and use import size_limit to downscale without modifying the source; the stated legacy GPU limits are compatibility guidance rather than guaranteed modern hardware capabilities.
For banding compare renderer precision and debanding or texture dithering. Internal HDR rendering does not alone prove HDR display output; verify the 4.7 output pipeline separately.

Treat camera near/far adjustments as an evidence-based response to depth artifacts, with near clipping regression checks; platform depth precision descriptions require reverse-Z and backend source verification.

Alpha blending sorts whole objects and omits transparent geometry from normal-roughness buffers. Priority and sorting offset cannot fix every intersecting surface; select scissor, hash, prepass or dither according to required coverage and feature support.

Use Label3D for frequently changing world text and TextMesh for actual extruded geometry and custom material deformation. Label3D does not inherit Control themes, so configure font resources and appearance explicitly.
Default transparent glyph quads can have sorting and shadow limitations; compare alpha-cut and opaque-prepass modes with the intended font edge quality. Enable font mipmaps or MSDF for distant text.

Projected Controls retain GUI themes and rich text, but require camera unproject_position output converted into the actual Control parent coordinates, behind-camera checks, resize handling and optional occlusion queries.
TextMesh only supports dynamic font outlines and can fail on self-intersections; test the actual font and languages, and measure regeneration cost before dynamic text use.

Route 3D fundamentals and procedural geometry separately from materials, lighting and optimization; LOD, visibility ranges, occlusion, resolution scaling and VRS address different bottlenecks and need measured selection.
Use the GI comparison entry to choose VoxelGI, SDFGI, LightmapGI, probes or artistic substitutes; renderer and dynamic geometry requirements decide which references need implementation detail.

Automatic LOD generation follows 3D scene import, while OBJ mesh-resource imports need Scene import mode before reimport. Verify skinned mesh artifacts and disable generation per affected mesh when needed.
Compare fixed camera and renderer primitive counts and frame times with mesh LOD enabled/disabled; fewer primitives do not guarantee improvement when another bottleneck dominates.
Viewport mesh_lod_threshold is a screen-space metric accounting for resolution and FOV; GeometryInstance3D lod_bias adjusts individual quality and ReflectionProbe has a separate capture threshold.
All MultiMesh or particle instances share a selected LOD based on node bounds. Spatially partition distant instances and maintain accurate particle AABBs to improve LOD and culling together.

Fit probes to rooms with box projection where the geometry supports it, and adjust origin_offset to avoid capturing from inside a solid. Max distance changes capture reach rather than the probe visibility range.

Use Once updates for static captures and measure Always capture costs; disable capture shadows or reduce captured object cull masks and LOD quality where appropriate. Baked light shadows remain in captures.
Blend probe volumes with small deliberate overlaps and use SSR for visible detail with probe fallback for off-screen information; scene changes require planned capture refresh.

Renderer limits differ: Forward+ shares clustered-element budget across lights, decals and probes, Mobile and Compatibility apply fewer probes per mesh. Verify actual defaults and the stale extents/ambient property labels against 4.7 class bindings.
VoxelGI needs Forward+ and baked static geometry within a tightly fitted volume. Save VoxelGIData to an external binary .res and include it in export and relocation checks.

Mesh Disabled still receives GI; Static contributes baked geometry that must be rebaked after changes, while Dynamic contribution costs more. Light bake modes independently control illumination update behavior.

Static ShaderMaterial meshes bake as black blockers and several BaseMaterial3D UV properties are ignored; verify material contribution visually or deliberately select dynamic contribution where its cost is justified.

Diagnose leaks by sealed geometry and thickness relative to voxel size before increasing normal bias. Bias can hide artifacts while worsening light leaks; verify volume overlaps and instance limits when GI flickers.
Use controlled before/after GPU timing for subdivisions, cone-trace quality and half-resolution changes; these alter bake cost, storage or runtime shading differently.

SDFGI is Forward+ only and follows the camera without manually fitted volumes. Dynamic lights can update GI but dynamic occluders and emissive meshes do not contribute correctly in the same way as VoxelGI.
Changing nearby static geometry needs cascade regeneration or deliberate disable/enable refresh; do not promise immediate door occlusion updates from merely marking the mesh Dynamic.

Cell size, cascade distance and max distance are linked controls. Fast camera motion increases regeneration work; test teleports and scene changes with measured warmup and convergence before revealing the scene.
Bounce feedback can become unstable and brighten the scene over seconds; test temporal behavior, then tune feedback and energy instead of accepting a single-frame screenshot.
Balance ray count, convergence frames, light update frequency and half resolution using fixed camera trajectories and dynamic-light scenarios; note transparent surfaces receive rougher reflections.

Choose GI by renderer support, dynamic geometry and lights, visual needs, bake workflow and measured budget. The page performance ranking and desktop SDFGI default recommendation are contextual guidance rather than universal benchmark results.
LightmapGI can render across backends but its baking needs RenderingDevice-capable hardware and static UV2 setup. Dynamic objects receive baked probes without contributing new GI.
SSIL supplements small on-screen dynamic detail using previous-frame color; it cannot represent off-screen large structures reliably and offers no reflection solution.
VoxelGI real-time lighting still requires geometry preparation and baking; runtime bake availability does not make its several-second cost suitable for arbitrary gameplay regeneration.

Configure mesh GI mode separately from light bake mode, and document which effects remain disabled, static or dynamic under the chosen GI technique. Offer appropriate environment or artistic-light fallback when advanced GI is unavailable.
Godot occlusion culling adds CPU work for a low-resolution occluder buffer and tests whole occludee AABBs; measure benefit on fixed indoor/open camera paths rather than enabling it universally.
Bake simplified static opaque MeshInstance3D occluders and exclude dynamic visual layers. MultiMesh, particles and unconverted CSG need manual representative shapes; they can still be occludees.
Inspect the occlusion debug buffer when visible objects vanish, then rebake after level changes, remove accidentally baked dynamic objects and reduce overaggressive simplification.
Moving an occluder or its parent rebuilds acceleration structures. For a door keep a static separate occluder and hide it during opening, restoring only when closed.
When objects never cull, inspect full AABB coverage, extra_cull_margin and ignore_occlusion_culling. Partition large instance groups and compare draw counts alongside total CPU/GPU frame time.
Use CSG for blockout and boolean prototypes, with separate small trees for unrelated objects. Child/tree order and combiner boundaries determine union/intersection/subtraction outcomes.
Custom CSG meshes require closed manifold indexed geometry with correctly paired triangle edges and winding; visually closed surfaces with duplicated incompatible indices are insufficient.

Bake finalized CSG to a sibling MeshInstance3D for lightmaps, occluder baking and faster loading, then hide the original to avoid duplicate geometry. Preserve original separately for subsequent edits.
Bake Collision Shape needs an appropriate StaticBody3D or AnimatableBody3D parent; visual mesh baking alone does not install collisions. Verify source collision visibility and save/reload state.
Triplanar materials help blockout without UV editing but have shader costs and GI bake limitations; the article is marked outdated, so verify editor commands and geometry backend against 4.7.
Choose antialiasing by edge, alpha-cutout and specular artifacts separately. MSAA handles geometry coverage; alpha-to-coverage assists cutouts while roughness filtering targets specular shimmer.

TAA and FSR2 need Forward+ and introduce temporal blur or ghosting; test moving objects, camera cuts and shader motion rather than a static comparison. Native-resolution FSR2 raises GPU cost rather than improving performance.
FXAA/SMAA offer spatial filtering in Forward+ and Mobile, while Compatibility requires supported alternatives. 2D and 3D MSAA are independent settings.
Supersampling scale is per-axis so two means four times the pixels and high VRAM use; use fixed output resolution and report internal scale when benchmarking.
Roughness-on-import needs the correct packed channel and paired normal map followed by reimport; runtime roughness limiter and import preprocessing solve different cases.
Expose quality choices that are valid for the active renderer and measured target hardware instead of treating the page generic low-end FXAA recommendation as a hard capability limit.

Separate emitter simulation, rendered particle meshes and environment interaction nodes when routing 3D VFX. CPU particle support differs from GPU shaders, trails, subemitters, attractors and collision; select a supported feature subset for each renderer.
A GPUParticles3D setup requires both a process material and at least one draw-pass mesh; process material controls simulation rather than surface shading.
Additional draw passes reuse simulation but add rendered geometry/material work; profile them rather than treating simulation reuse as zero rendering cost.
GPU-to-CPU conversion loses multiple draw passes and several simulation features; create and visually verify the fallback instead of assuming conversion preserves behavior.

Generate surface, directed-surface or volume emission points from an explicit source mesh. Generated point positions are relative to the emitter, so changed relative mesh transforms need regeneration.
Directed points need normal data associated with the same point index; color data modulates material color. These are encoded data textures, not arbitrary display textures.
Keep point_count within generated texture capacity and save emission textures with the process material; increasing the count cannot create missing sample data.
Assign a separate particle system through sub_emitter, then enable the parent process-material subemitter mode; linked children have ordinary emitting disabled intentionally.
Reject self-links and recursive emitter cycles. Editable Children permits instanced-scene property editing but does not establish safe acyclic runtime relationships automatically.

The child Amount caps active subparticles even when multiple parent particles trigger events; dimension child capacity and verify saturation under worst-case overlap. Its normal explosiveness property does not control event-triggered spawning.
Enable process-material attractor interaction and match attractor cull_mask to particle visual layers; this mask is independent of physics collision layers.

Use signed strength for attraction versus repulsion, attenuation for spatial falloff and directionality for a rotated local Z-axis force. Verify dimensional size and scaling against 4.7 class bindings rather than stale Extents labels.

Vector-field Texture3D color values encode signed direction and magnitude around neutral 0.5; texture Y convention differs from world Y. Test a simple known directional field before a procedural NoiseTexture3D.
3D attractor behavior should not be promised for 2D particles; use the appropriate shader or other implementation only after verifying support.
GPU particle collision is separate from the gameplay PhysicsServer world. Configure process-material collision behavior and particle collision nodes with matching visual-layer masks.

Use height fields for outdoor top surfaces, accepting that they cannot represent tunnels or stacked rooms. When Moved refreshes on height-field node motion rather than individual geometry motion; Always must be profiled.
Use baked SDF collision for overhangs and tunnels in supported renderers, save baked data and rebake after geometry changes; bake_mask and affected-particle cull_mask have different roles.

Missing collisions may result from nonoverlapping particle visibility AABB and collider bounds. Regenerate accurate bounds before changing geometry, then compare fixed FPS or collider thickness for high-speed tunneling.
The tutorial uses old Extents labels and describes primitive sphere nonuniform scaling permissively; verify supported shape scaling and size properties in the pinned classes before scripting.
Amount sets particle capacity while amount_ratio changes emission density without restarting existing particles; budget simulation and allocated capacity separately from currently emitted particles.

Fixed FPS controls simulation update frequency including collisions and attraction, while speed_scale controls temporal rate. Interpolation smooths rendering between updates but cannot add missing collision steps.

Size visibility_aabb for worst-case motion and interaction bounds. Local_coords changes particle gravity and direction reference space; verify a rotating emitter before selecting world-trail behavior.

The opening statement that particles process and render only while emitting is checked is misleading: disabling emission can leave existing particles alive until lifetime ends. Verify actual completion and cleanup timing rather than freeing on the toggle alone.
Amount/lifetime is a baseline continuous emission rate that changes with amount_ratio, explosiveness and sub-emitter mode; report all parameters when measuring.
Enable turbulence and give particles an existing motion source; it modifies movement rather than replacing initial motion configuration.
Differentiate noise contrast, spatial scale and pattern panning speed from particle velocity. Sample per-particle influence and lifetime curves separately from initial-position displacement.

3D noise adds GPU work; establish target-platform renderer support and measured concurrent-emitter budget, then provide a simpler fallback when needed instead of adopting a fixed emitter count as proof.

Trails need supported Forward+/Mobile renderer, trails_enabled, a RibbonTrailMesh or TubeTrailMesh draw pass and surface-material use_particle_trails together; missing any one can explain broken rendering.

Choose flat ribbons with billboard alignment or crossed ribbons for angle visibility. Sections control path bend resolution while section segments/rings refine the shape curve; measure geometry cost independently.
Tube trails should align Y to velocity to avoid flattening during turns. Validate trail length duration, mesh dimensions and visibility bounds under the fastest motion.
ParticleProcessMaterial simulation outputs need surface-material vertex-color-as-albedo and Particle Billboard frame configuration to become visible color and flipbook effects.

Separate acceleration curves from direct velocity: zero acceleration preserves current velocity, while damping affects translational motion rather than angular velocity. Verify Damping as Friction semantics in class/source before adopting the prose naming.
Direction without a speed or acceleration source produces no motion. Plane flags, local_coords and rotation/billboard flags decide which axes simulation and visible rotation use.

Collision mode, friction, bounce and scale-aware size work with separate GPU collision nodes; sub-emitter modes require an assigned child and capacity sized for event overlap. Keep Velocity copies parent event-time velocity.
The page Keep Size requirement for particle scaling and universal Y-axis tangential acceleration description need binding/source verification; retain tested behavior rather than copy broad claims.
Converting the process material to ShaderMaterial freezes the enabled feature implementation into shader code; save and inspect it, then validate future feature changes as shader changes.

Use ArrayMesh or SurfaceTool for built geometry, ImmediateMesh for small frequently changed debug shapes, and MeshDataTool only when adjacency information is required. Mesh resources need a rendering node, and shared resources intentionally share edits.
Indexed vertices share attributes as well as positions; split vertices at UV or hard-normal seams rather than deduplicating solely by position.

The page statement that Godot does not support GPU geometry generation is too broad for the RenderingDevice extension boundary; these particular tutorial tools are CPU-side and should be described as such.
Set attributes before adding each ImmediateMesh vertex and complete each surface with surface_end. Explicitly clear surfaces before a full per-frame rebuild or geometry accumulates indefinitely.

Small debug geometry is an appropriate use; generated surfaces are cached after creation, so static draw cost and repeated generation cost differ. Avoid regenerating thousands of vertices without measured need.
Validate MeshInstance3D.mesh is the expected ImmediateMesh and is not shared with unrelated nodes before clearing or appending surfaces.
SurfaceTool captures configured attributes on add_vertex and commit appends a surface to an existing ArrayMesh; define the intended clear-versus-append behavior before rebuilding.

The conceptual attribute example omits required arguments and is not executable. The C# four-corner quad example duplicates two positions instead of four distinct corners; build an actual nondegenerate indexed quad and assert triangle area.
Generate normals only for triangle primitives, then tangents after valid UVs and normals exist for normal-mapped materials. Preserve hard edges through explicit smoothing groups.
The prose references add_smooth_group although current API naming must be verified; use pinned class bindings rather than copying old helper names.
MeshDataTool supports triangle ArrayMesh surfaces and calculates vertex-edge-face adjacency; check create_from_surface errors and source type before traversing.
Edits remain in MeshDataTool until commit_to_surface. The example clear_surfaces removes every mesh surface, so preserve unrelated surfaces and materials in real project modifications.

Reset accumulated normals before summing deformed face normals, then normalize; the example adds to existing source normals and only approximates the intended result. Guard degenerate faces and map signed normal components before using them as display colors.
Duplicate a shared mesh when only one instance should deform; verify new bounds, collision representation and persisted output independently from visible vertex changes.

Resize surface arrays to Mesh.ARRAY_MAX and populate typed packed arrays in enum slots; validate equal per-vertex attribute counts, tangent/bone/weight strides, index range and triangle grouping before adding a surface.

Clockwise winding controls visible faces separately from lighting normals. UV seam duplication and pole degeneracy need deliberate handling in the sphere generator, with positive radius and nonzero ring/segment counts.
Template snippets intentionally omit array setup or geometry generation and are not runnable as pasted; produce a complete isolated recipe and assert actual surface counts, bounds and triangle area.

ResourceSaver.FLAG_COMPRESS only applies to binary resource types according to pinned class_resourcesaver line117; the .tres example does not establish compressed output. Check save errors and reload the generated mesh from an appropriate writable path.

GridMap places optimized MeshLibrary items rather than arbitrary gameplay node scenes. Export requires root Node3D with direct MeshInstance3D children, optional supported collision and navigation child structure.
Assign materials on mesh surfaces because MeshInstance3D node material overrides are ignored by MeshLibrary export; verify rendered appearance after exporting and reloading the library.
NavigationMesh baked cell size must match navigation-map cell size for cell connectivity, and small-cell agent radius settings need actual cross-cell path tests.
Generate lightmap UV2 and intended texel scale before MeshLibrary export; changing source import settings later does not mutate the existing library.
GridMap collision layers apply to the grid, while the page physics-material wording mistakenly references NavigationMesh; keep physics and navigation configuration separate.

Enable physical light units with editor restart, then coordinate light intensities, sky background intensity and CameraAttributes on runtime camera and WorldEnvironment so editor preview exposure is also controlled.

Directional intensity uses lux, positional/area sources use lumens, and background luminance uses nits; arbitrary energy and color still multiply physical values, so document both when matching a reference.

The tutorial incorrectly says scripted shutter speed uses seconds. Pinned class_cameraattributesphysical line150 defines duration as 1/shutter_speed seconds with default100; use reciprocal-time values and verify actual exposure in the engine.

Physical camera attributes own focal length, FOV and clipping and may add depth-of-field cost. Auto exposure cannot recover precision lost by excessive dynamic range, and ISO/shutter parameters do not simulate camera noise or motion trails.
Test dark-to-bright transitions and HDR/SDR output separately; physical units do not guarantee a better image or validated HDR display calibration.

Camera Environment overrides WorldEnvironment, while editor preview sun/sky is not runtime content. CameraAttributes are separate exposure/DOF resources and current-camera attributes override the world default. Verify one-environment constraints per World3D when using separate viewports.

Choose sky texture format and HDR exposure clamping deliberately; sky background can influence ambient and reflected lighting even when not visible. Separate background mode, diffuse ambient and specular source settings.

SSAO supports a simplified Compatibility implementation since 4.6 with only radius and intensity controls. SSR and SSIL remain Forward+-specific; test opaque-buffer and off-screen limitations with moving objects.

Compatibility glow differs from Forward+/Mobile and lacks several controls. HDR2D requires correct source_color color-texture hints and changes alpha blending and apparent font weight, so verify UI visuals after enabling.
Keep GUI outside affected Canvas background layers when using glow or blur. Full-screen glow replacement blur varies with viewport resolution and requires a supported renderer feature set.
Tonemapping and later color correction are separate stages. Import a LUT as Texture3D with matching slice layout and test a neutral LUT first before artistic changes.
