Use send_text for JSON or text protocols, because put_packet and default send produce binary frames; decode according to was_string_packet after receiving.
Keep polling after close until STATE_CLOSED, and read close code or reason only then; a negative close code forces unnotified closure and a reason must fit below 123 UTF-8 bytes.

Web exports cannot set handshake headers or ping intervals, accept server streams, query remote IP/port or change TCP no-delay; design browser authentication and liveness around available application protocol behavior.
Use a matching hostname and secure wss endpoint for browser mixed-content and certificate checks; do not remove TLS validation as a routine connection fix.
Bound queued packet count and buffer sizes, inspect outbound buffered amount and send errors, and test slow receivers to establish backpressure handling.
Use packed signed 64-bit storage only when 32-bit range is insufficient; overflow wraps, so validate external numbers before converting inventory IDs or save counters.
Assignment shares packed arrays, duplicate creates independent data, and built-in property getters return copies requiring reassignment; test mutation ownership explicitly.
get rejects negative indexes and returns zero on failure without pausing the editor, whereas [] accepts relative negative indexes and errors out of bounds; zero cannot serve as an error sentinel.
bsearch requires sorted data and can return an insertion position rather than a matching item; bounds-check and compare the found value before treating it as a successful lookup.
Preallocate with resize and inspect both the Error and actual size before filling; erase removes only the first matching value and slice end is exclusive.

to_byte_array emits eight bytes per element without defining a portable protocol in this page; specify and verify endian/version contracts before using it as a network or save format, and use the distinct C# binding conventions.
LabelSettings overrides Control theme text properties; inspect an attached resource when a Theme change appears ineffective.
Shared resources change every attached Label on mutation; duplicate for per-label variants and reload saved resources to verify intended sharing.
Line spacing adds pixels to descent and can be negative; paragraph spacing adds further space, so test multiline localized strings for clipping and overlaps.
Transparent shadow alpha disables the base shadow, while stacked shadows and outlines need valid zero-based indices after insertion, removal or moves.
Verify font readability and effect layering visually at the target UI scale; property setters alone cannot establish readable output.
Storage quantizes values to 32-bit floats even though GDScript reads them as 64-bit float; define numerical tolerances for round trips instead of expecting source precision to survive.
Reject or specially handle NaN before sorting, binary search, membership or erase because these operations do not follow ordinary number behavior for NaN.
Packed arrays share references unless duplicated, while built-in getters return copies; verify mutation ownership and reassign changed property values.
get rejects negative indices and returns zero on failure whereas [] supports relative negative indices and raises an error; precheck bounds so zero remains valid data.
resize returns an Error and actual size must be checked before filling; to_byte_array emits four bytes per value, but a portable storage or wire format still needs an explicit encoding contract.
Initialize from an Array of Vector4 values, not a flat sequence of components; validate the layout before building shader or geometry buffers.
Ordinary packed array assignment shares data, duplicate isolates mutations, and built-in getters return copies requiring reassignment.
NaN in any vector component makes sort and exact membership/search results unreliable; validate finite components before indexing sorted vector data.
get returns a zero vector for invalid or negative indices while [] permits relative negative indexing and errors out of bounds; explicitly check bounds instead of using zero as failure.

Use resize plus indexed writes for bulk construction and inspect the Error and actual size; byte conversion does not document a fixed portable per-vector format here, so verify precision and ABI before exchange.
Choose texture-based progress bars when custom three-layer art is required; Theme styling belongs to ordinary ProgressBar and does not replace these textures.
Set Range minimum, maximum and step deliberately; the default step is one and can quantize a normalized health ratio. Validate empty, intermediate and full visuals.
Nine-patch margins only operate when nine_patch_stretch is enabled; radial progress texture stretching differs from under and over nine-patch handling.
Radial center offsets remain inside the progress texture bounds; add transparent canvas space to the asset when an external center is required.
Use texture_progress_offset to align fill art with decorative frames, and per-layer tints when changing only fill color rather than modulating the whole control.
Validate partial-angle radial fills at both extrema because max_value reaches radial_fill_degrees rather than necessarily displaying a complete circle.
Use monotonic ticks for elapsed time, performance sampling and timeouts; system wall-clock values may jump after user or OS adjustments.
Unix system time always returns UTC seconds with fractional precision, while local-system dictionaries depend on utc flags; persist a clearly specified timezone contract.
Datetime conversions do not apply timezone offsets, DST or leap seconds and do not handle Z suffixes; normalize external timestamps deliberately rather than silently treating local text as UTC.
String conversions discard fractional seconds, and dictionary conversions ignore dst; preserve required precision and offset metadata separately.
Missing dictionary fields default to the Unix epoch and empty dictionaries map to zero, so validate required fields before interpreting an apparently successful timestamp.

The datetime-from-unix prose claims parity with the default local-system dictionary, conflicting with no-timezone-conversion semantics; test actual UTC/local behavior and do not adopt that equivalence.

Inspect compilation errors and nonempty bytecode for every required shader stage before creating a RenderingDevice shader; a default resource has empty errors and empty bytecode, so empty error text alone is insufficient.
SPIR-V portability across GPU models does not establish support for a particular stage or pipeline feature; gate ray tracing and tessellation against actual device and backend capabilities.
Stage bytecode getters return copies requiring reassignment; use set_stage_bytecode when intentionally replacing a stage.

The property list includes ray tracing stages omitted by the generic stage-method prose; verify enum bindings for any_hit, closest_hit, miss, intersection and raygen rather than limiting support solely from that prose.
The API property spelling tesselation differs from normal English tessellation; use verified names and preserve compile diagnostics alongside source version information.
Set initial scroll offsets with set_deferred because scrollbar ranges are not initialized in ready; wait a process frame before ensure_control_visible on newly added children.
Use follow_focus and a visible focus border for keyboard or gamepad navigation, and verify indirect focused children scroll fully into view.
SHOW_NEVER hides a usable scrollbar whereas DISABLED prevents scrolling; RESERVE stabilizes content size and MAXIMIZE_FIRST grows toward content before scrolling under constraints.
Never remove or free internal HScrollBar or VScrollBar nodes; hide or disable them through scroll mode properties.
scroll_started and scroll_ended only report touch dragging, not wheels, scrollbar drags or keyboard events; use other state observations for general scroll tracking.
Scroll hints are not shown when both axes can scroll; the bottom/right enum prose repeats horizontal for bottom, so verify intended vertical behavior visually.
array * transform inversely transforms all points only for an orthonormal basis; use affine_inverse multiplication for scaled or skewed parent transforms.
Initialize from Vector2 values and retain coordinate-space contracts for navigation paths or outlines; packed storage cannot indicate whether points are local or global.
Duplicate shared arrays when editing independently and reassign built-in getter copies after mutation.
get rejects relative negative indices and returns zero on invalid input, unlike [] which supports negatives; check bounds explicitly so the origin stays valid data.
NaN components invalidate ordinary sort and membership assumptions, and bsearch returns an insertion position on absence; validate finite data and compare the located item.
Resize once for bulk point construction, check Error and actual size, and verify byte format before using raw conversion in external storage.
Distinguish unit curve domain 0..1 from output range; particles and Line2D width expect unit input even when output values differ.
Point min/max values do not bound tangent overshoot between points; sample extrema before using a curve for health, opacity or other bounded gameplay values.
sample_baked lazily builds a cache; choose bake_resolution by measured interpolation error and pre-bake when avoiding a first-use spike matters.
clean_dupes removes neighboring points within engine epsilon; verify intended tightly spaced discontinuities before cleaning authored data.
Documentation calls tangents degree angles although linear mode describes slopes; verify pinned binding and simple numeric samples before translating editor angles into add_point tangent numbers.
Point offset changes may reorder curve points; verify returned index and saved readback before continuing edits by cached indices.
Expansion margins extend only the drawn box, not the clickable Control area; increase content margins or actual control size when improving usable hit targets.
Overlapping corner radii are proportionally reduced to fit available dimensions; test narrow controls instead of expecting configured large radii to appear unchanged.
Choose corner_detail for the displayed radius and profile large collections; detail one makes chamfered corners and disabling antialiasing avoids recommended 45-degree glitches.
Antialiasing draws a transparent ring and larger sizes can blur or artifact on small rounded boxes; inspect target scale rather than treating it as universal smoothing.
Shadow color has no effect until shadow_size is at least one, and draw_center can be disabled for overlay focus outlines.
Skew can bring text against drawn edges; use content padding rather than decorative expansion to reserve text space.
Confirm the active listener: the camera is default, and a separate AudioListener3D must be made current. Hiding a player does not stop or mute its sound.
Enable Doppler tracking on both emitter and active listener for relative motion, choosing physics or idle tracking to match movement updates.
A missing audio bus silently falls back to Master; check actual bus existence after loading the bus layout and test Area3D routing with area_mask, which defaults to zero.
max_distance adds linear cutoff regardless of attenuation model and can avoid distant audio mixing; calibrate it together with unit_size and profile dense ambient sources.
play queues output for the next physics frame and playing includes queued output; verify audibility and playback lifecycle after advancing the relevant frame.
max_polyphony cuts the oldest sound when exceeded, pitch_scale also changes tempo, and distance low-pass can be disabled with the documented high cutoff.
finished prose only says audio stops and does not distinguish explicit stop from natural completion; verify runtime signal behavior before using it as universal cleanup.
Keep imported scene data in a fresh GLTFState; GLTFDocument and extensions are stateless processors with export settings, and per-scene custom data belongs in state or node additional data.
Check append and write Error results, provide base_path for external dependencies, then reload generated output to verify textures, skeletons and animations.
Root modes preserve different hierarchy information; MULTI_ROOT discards root properties except name, while SINGLE_ROOT uses a Godot extension that other importers may treat as KEEP_ROOT.
Default texture remapping changed from Godot 4.6 to 4.7; preserve original maps for custom shaders only when the material interpretation is explicitly implemented.
Invisible-node export can require KHR_node_visibility, optionally risk visible objects elsewhere, or omit nodes completely; choose according to consumer support and test the chosen importer.
PNG fallback quality scales image dimensions whereas JPEG fallback quality controls compression; lossy quality one remains lossy.

Object-model export/import prose points to oppositely named extension callbacks; verify binding callback routing before implementing mappings, and register extensions before querying supported extension lists.
Use Vector2i for exact grid coordinates but validate signed 32-bit component bounds; double-precision engine builds do not widen this integer type.
Vector2 conversion truncates toward zero; use explicit floor for negative world-to-cell mapping, or the relevant TileMap conversion API.
Integer remainder preserves negative signs; use component-wise posmod when wrapping coordinates into positive chunk or map extents.
Vector ordering is lexicographic X then Y, not component-wise containment or distance ordering; use clamp or explicit per-axis comparisons for bounds.
Vector2i.ZERO is false in boolean context yet represents a valid origin cell; use explicit success flags or nullable results.
Float scalar multiplication and division return Vector2, while integer scalar operations retain Vector2i; avoid accidentally quantizing movement or choosing the wrong overload.
Squared distance can avoid square roots but extreme coordinates require overflow validation; check zero height before aspect calculations.
TextLine draws from the bounding-box top-left rather than a baseline position; use ascent/descent metrics when mixing it with baseline-oriented CanvasItem text.
hit_test always supplies a valid caret offset, even outside the text extent; check the bounding box separately before accepting pointer interactions.
Inline object keys must be unique and occupy replacement-character length in the source; inspect object rectangles and resizing when mixing icons with multilingual spans.
BiDi override ranges must cover the whole source without overlap; test mixed RTL, LTR and embedded objects rather than reversing strings manually.
Positive draw oversampling overrides viewport font oversampling; verify at actual canvas scale and use the measured width or height according to text orientation.
Vector4i components stay signed 32-bit regardless of engine floating precision; use int or PackedInt64Array for wider counters.
Float-to-integer construction truncates toward zero and negative remainder uses truncated division; choose floor or posmod explicitly for partitioned coordinates.
Comparison operators sort lexicographically X/Y/Z/W and do not perform four-axis containment checks.
The float-multiplication example uses literal 2 despite claiming a floating return; use 2.0 to select the float overload and compile or execute examples.
ZERO remains valid data despite false boolean conversion; keep explicit success information.
Min and max axis tie handling chooses W and X respectively; test deterministic tie behavior before relying on axis selection.
Set region, cell shape, size and offset before update, then apply solidity and weights; update clears all per-point solid and weight data, so calling it after obstacle edits erases them.
Choose Manhattan with orthogonal movement and suitable diagonal modes to prevent corner cutting; default ALWAYS accepts diagonals around solid neighboring cells.
Jumping speeds search but ignores weight scaling; keep it disabled when terrain costs affect chosen routes and compare path cost before optimizing.
A disabled start returns empty even when start equals target; partial paths end at the closest reachable point and do not prove destination reachability.
Partial searches toward solid destinations can be unusually slow; profile blocked-goal cases and avoid per-frame full searches.
get_point_path is not thread-safe on the same instance; use exclusive ownership or synchronization rather than sharing one grid across workers.
Returned point positions use configured cell mapping and are not automatically TileMap world positions; test offset and isometric layouts.
Style the numeric input through LineEdit theme items or SpinBoxInnerLineEdit variation; preserve the required internal LineEdit node and never free it.
The alignment example uses names inconsistent with the listed alignment property and GlobalScope HorizontalAlignment enum; verify both GDScript and C# bindings instead of copying those examples.
update_on_text_changed evaluates incomplete expressions and removes trailing operators; keep submit-based evaluation for arithmetic entry and explicitly apply pending text before reading settings.
Arrow step and rounding still respect Range.step, so configure actual precision separately from arrow increments.
Disabling the context menu enables right-click min/max behavior; test that interaction before using it as a menu customization.
updown icon overrides separate up/down icons and does not change with state; inspect disabled, focus, hover and pressed appearance with the intended theme.
Register gizmo plugins with EditorPlugin before expecting handles; use _has_gizmo for generic gizmos or _create_gizmo for custom instances, returning null for unrelated nodes.
Capture initial values through _get_handle_value and commit a do/undo action only on accepted edits; cancellation restores the value directly without adding an undo action.
Subgizmo transforms are local to the associated Node3D; apply ray or frustum selection with unique nonnegative IDs and preserve restore transforms across group editing.
Custom priority defaults to zero above built-in -1, so test overlapping built-in and custom handles and set priority intentionally.
Clear previous visual elements during redraw and use gizmo-aware material lookup for selected/editable variants; repeated redraw must not accumulate geometry.
_begin_handle_action lacks descriptive documentation; verify source behavior before adding special lifecycle assumptions. Test click-without-change, cancel, undo, redo and saved readback.
Use convex or primitive shapes for volumetric triggers; concave trimesh shapes are hollow and may miss expected interior overlap behavior.
Distinguish monitoring from monitorable and validate target collision layer against the detecting area mask. Overlap arrays update with physics, not immediately after moving a node.

Resolve shape signal indices through shape_find_owner and shape_owner_get_owner; GridMap and server-created objects require type and integration checks rather than blindly calling CollisionObject methods.
Higher-priority areas apply first, world defaults last; combine and replace variants either stop lower priorities or continue accumulation, so test overlapping gravity zones.
Point gravity with unit distance zero is constant, whereas positive distance establishes inverse-square falloff; nonnormalized direction also scales ordinary gravity.
Wind only affects SoftBody3D, and Godot Physics does not report SoftBody overlap events; do not advertise general rigid-body wind or universal soft-body triggers.
Audio routing requires override or reverb enabled plus appropriate AudioStreamPlayer3D area mask; verify actual buses and listener output.
Modify direct body state within RigidBody2D integration callbacks; preserve physics ownership instead of setting ordinary node transforms every rendered frame.
Forces are applied per physics update while impulses represent one-time events; constant forces accumulate until explicitly cleared, so do not repeatedly add a constant force unintentionally.
Positioned force, impulse and velocity-at-local-position arguments are global-axis offsets from the origin, despite local naming; distinguish offset from an absolute world point.
get_contact_local_position reports a global point on this body, while contact local normal documentation is terse; verify a rotated-body fixture before assigning coordinate interpretations.
Angular velocity is radians per second, linear velocity pixels per second, and step is the simulation delta; use the actual state timestep for custom integration.
Contact counts require reporting configuration and bounded indices; collider objects depend on creation path and may not be scene nodes.
integrate_forces applies a gravity/damping tick; test custom-integrator settings to avoid double integration, and use setters rather than attempting to mutate read-only inverse inertia.
Select a current camera per nearest Viewport, not globally per tree; clearing current can automatically activate another camera unless enable_next is false.

Use project_ray_origin and project_ray_normal together for picking across perspective and orthographic projections; project_position depth is a plane depth rather than a universal ray travel distance.
unproject_position returns viewport coordinates; transform them into the target Control parent coordinate space and reject behind-camera positions or apply a stricter frustum check.
Culling masks control direct visibility but GI includes all layers; disable mesh GI or light bake contribution explicitly when hidden-layer objects must not affect lighting.
Choose keep_aspect and FOV according to target viewport aspect; orthographic size uses world units despite a method hint calling them pixels.
get_camera_transform includes camera offsets and subclass adjustments; use it instead of assuming Node3D global_transform is the rendered viewpoint.
Reduce near only after checking renderer-specific depth precision and Z fighting; far reduction only helps when it culls actual work.
The fov prose describes an axis relationship ambiguously relative to default vertical examples; verify the projection matrix on portrait and landscape fixtures.
AnimationNode is a Resource graph node, not a scene Node; keep per-tree runtime memory in parameters because one resource may be reused across scenes and trees.
The legacy _process customization method is deprecated with explicitly incomplete GDScript support; do not promise arbitrary custom animation node behavior without using verified extension APIs.
Current length, position and delta parameters are read-only previous-frame information, with input precedence depending on node type; avoid treating them as current physics-tick output.
Blend time is relative delta except on seeks where it is absolute; propagate external seek and test-only state without advancing persistent gameplay state during probes.
Remove inputs only when inactive, check add/rename failure and missing find_input -1, and retest connections after resource topology changes.
Processing AnimationTree instance ID is valid only inside AnimationNodeExtension processing; do not cache or query it as permanent ownership.
Filters require both path selection and enabled state, and pass/stop/blend actions differ; verify body-part tracks using actual AnimationTree output and saved reload.
Keep interacting 2D physics objects in the same canvas; cross-CanvasLayer or viewport-canvas collision behavior is undefined even if shapes visually coincide.
Picking requires input_pickable, a nonzero collision layer and unhandled input reaching physics picking; inspect GUI event consumption before changing masks.
Mouse enter/exit does not continuously track fast motion and may be obscured by overlapping collision objects; do not make precise hover state dependent solely on balanced signals.
Shape owners are internal containers, not child nodes; resolve a physics shape index through shape_find_owner and then shape_owner_get_owner instead of using scene-child indexing.
Disabled process mode can remove physics, make a body static, or leave it active according to disable_mode; verify pause and resume behavior independently of script processing.
One-way collision prose describes reporting suppression too broadly and omits directional mechanics; test direction, margin and body approach from both sides using version-matched bindings.
Collision priority affects penetration recovery rather than providing a universal tunneling fix; preserve meaningful timestep, shape and motion diagnostics.
Selection and item_selected signals use indices, not stable item IDs; store durable settings through IDs or metadata and resolve index after list changes.
IDs are signed 32-bit; use metadata for external strings or wider identifiers rather than truncating them into item IDs.
select can programmatically choose disabled items, and disabling the current item does not deselect it; explicitly validate and replace invalid settings selections.
First added item is automatically selected, select(-1) deselects, and allow_reselect controls user reselection; distinguish initialization from user-triggered callbacks.
fit_to_longest_item minimum size updates asynchronously; wait layout processing before asserting bounds after localization or item mutation.
Never free the required internal PopupMenu; use show_popup to compute correct placement and size instead of directly popping the internal window.
Search bar visibility requires enabled plus its count threshold, and fuzzy matching can include nonsequential near matches; test keyboard navigation and selection against filtered options.
